data.narrative:
Cover operates in Housing & Construction at Series B stage, having raised $100M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of four private peers in adjacent frontier sectors (Plantd Materials, Cuby Technologies, Somos, and Charge Robotics), with no direct public comparables available in the immediate subsector.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable triangulation lens here. Using total capital raised ($100M) as a proxy for enterprise value, a standard Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $190M. This methodology reflects typical venture capital expansion patterns across similar-stage construction and deep-tech businesses where revenue multiples remain difficult to establish given pre-scale trajectories.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $162M to $218M, with a median of $190M. The relatively tight band reflects the mechanical application of a single method rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties limiting robustness include reliance on a single valuation method, limited visibility into the private comp set's actual trading multiples or growth profiles, and the absence of public market pricing anchors. Refinement would require granular unit economics, revenue run-rate, and comparable transaction multiples from the four identified private peers.
